title: Purple Kaido
summary: A DON!! ramp deck. You add extra DON!! early with Basil Hawkins and Yamato, then spend it on DON!! minus effects. Your Leader gives a Character -2000 power on every attack, on both players' turns.
gamePlan: Early turns: Queen (EB04-032) draws 2, Basil Hawkins and Yamato add extra DON!! so you're ahead.
Your Leader, when attacking or being attacked: return 1 DON!! (DON!! -1) to give an opposing Character -2000 power. Use it to win battles and set up K.O.s.
King (6 cost) is hard to K.O.: return a DON!! instead. It's your best mid-game attacker.
Late game: two 10-cost Kaidos, the 9-cost Queen and Charlotte Linlin (ST34-004). Queen stops two Characters from attacking; Linlin sets a Character's power to 0.
Purple decks spend DON!! by returning it. Kaido (OP17-062) gives some back, so plan the order of your effects.

keyCards.why: Leader. DON!! -1 on attack or defense: -2000 power to a Character.
Basil Hawkins. 3 cost, adds an active DON!!.
King. Survives K.O.s by returning a DON!!.
Kaido. 12000 [Blocker] that refunds DON!! when you spend it.
Queen. [Banish], draws, and stops 2 Characters from attacking.

howItWins: You get ahead on DON!!, play 10-cost Characters earlier than your opponent can answer them, and use the Leader to win every key battle.
weakTo: Fast decks that attack before your ramp pays off.
Removal on your DON!! makers early in the game.
mulliganTips: Keep Basil Hawkins or Yamato. Ramp is the whole plan.
